hook: Bharat Summit speaker says her India visa was *cancelled*
hook_b: Bharat Summit speaker says her India visa was *cancelled*
tldr: Helle Lyng of Oslo daily Dagsavisen posted on X that 'orders from above' in the Home Ministry cancelled her valid visa.

beats.what: Helle Lyng says she was due to fly on Nov 11 to speak at the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad.
beats.why: She links the refusal to a press-freedom question she asked PM Modi in Norway in May 2026.
beats.care: The summit runs in Hyderabad this week, and the panel she was on is about media and democracy.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: the same panel lists the Press Club of India president among speakers.

cards.q: Are you following the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad this week?

qs: What reason, if any, will officials give for the visa decision?
Who else is on the Nov 14 media panel?

facts.t: In her video she said there were still *48 hours* before her session.

steps.e: Asks PM Modi a press-freedom question in Norway
Says visa cancelled on day of travel

watch: Whether the Home Ministry comments, and whether she makes it to the Nov 14 session.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng says she has been stopped from coming to Hyderabad for Bharat Summit

fact: A Norwegian journalist invited to Hyderabad's Bharat Summit says her *visa was cancelled*.
twist: She was listed for a Day 2 media and press-freedom panel on *Nov 14*.
